name: AI Deep Dive — CACI — 2026-06-22
rationale: CACI International is a premier national security IT contractor transitioning from commoditized IT services to high-margin mission technology (photonics, cyber warfare, EW, spectrum superiority). The $28B+ backlog (3.2x TTM revenue) provides multi-year revenue visibility rarely seen outside defense primes. A 70%+ cleared workforce constitutes a genuine structural moat — Top Secret/SCI clearances take years to obtain, making the human capital base nearly impossible to replicate at scale. CACI's forward P/E of ~15x is at a discount to the defense IT sector median, reflecting DOGE/budget-cut anxiety already priced in. Weighted DCF fair value $434 is modestly below current price of $466 — accumulate on pullbacks toward $415-440.

bear.rationale: DOGE-driven defense IT consolidation: Broad federal spending freeze cuts CACI's contract pipeline by 20-25%. Budget sequestration scenario references 2011-2013 defense drawdown when government IT contractors saw 8-12% revenue declines. Net margin compresses as fixed costs spread over lower revenue base and competitive re-compete pressure intensifies. Low 13x exit PE reflects risk-off sentiment, near Industrials conservative benchmark (14x). Named risk: 2011-2013 Budget Control Act sequestration — defense IT services revenue declined 5-10% annually for 2 years.

base.rationale: Steady state: Defense modernization continues (NDAA baseline), CACI executes on $28B backlog at historical pace. 9% CAGR is within ±3pp of analyst Y1 consensus (10.8%) and reflects natural deceleration as revenue base grows. Net margin of 5.8% consistent with TTM (5.79%) and 4yr range of 5.48-5.91%. Exit P/E 17x vs Industrials median 18x — slight discount for government dependency. Quality multiplier 1.1 justified: (1) cleared workforce structural moat, (2) long-term contract incumbency with high switching costs. Modest -1.5%/yr buyback continues at historical pace.

bull.rationale: Specific catalyst: FY2027 NDAA AI mandates for DoD accelerate classified AI integration in IC/EW programs. CACI's photonics/free-space optical communications technology wins major Space Force and IC contracts (estimated $500M+ program), expanding into higher-margin proprietary hardware. Margin expands as tech mix shifts from cost-plus services to fixed-price proprietary solutions. Exit P/E 21x aligns with Leidos (~20x) and Booz Allen (~22x) peers at premium for demonstrated technology differentiation. Second catalyst: CACI's cyber operations division wins NSA/CYBERCOM re-compete.

aiThesis.rationale:
CACI International sits at a strategic inflection: a 60-year-old government IT incumbent actively converting its cleared workforce and national security relationships into proprietary defense technology. The $28B+ backlog (3.2x TTM revenue) is the central bull case anchor — it provides revenue visibility that commercial tech companies rarely have. The cleared workforce (70%+ TS/SCI) is a genuine structural moat: new entrants cannot simply hire their way to competitiveness in this space, making CACI's human capital genuinely hard to replicate at scale.

The DOGE/budget risk is real but mostly priced in at current levels (-23% in 3 months, -13% YTD). National security priorities — cyber warfare, EW, ISR, space — are typically protected even in budget-constrained environments. CACI's photonics/free-space optical communications capability represents real optionality into Space Force architecture, a high-margin proprietary hardware market if commercialized.

At $466, CACI trades at 14.93x forward P/E vs the defense IT sector median of ~18x. My 30/50/20 weighted DCF (bear/base/bull) yields fair value of $434 — 6.9% below current price. The stock is modestly overvalued, not egregiously. The cleaner read: this is a HOLD for existing holders and an ACCUMULATE on dips toward $415-440. The portfolio's standing decision to INITIATE_ON_DIP below $455 is well-calibrated to this model's output.

analyticsLog.shareCountMethod: shares_diluted — 22,091,305 shares. Confirmed from yfinance diluted share count (shares_diluted field).
analyticsLog.marginAnchor: 4yr average anchor applied. Historical net margins: 5.91%, 5.74%, 5.48%, 5.79%. 4yr avg = 5.73%. No clear directional trend (slight compression 2022-2024, recovery 2025) — mean-reverting rule applies. Base margin 5.8% is within ±5pp of 4yr avg.
analyticsLog.growthDerivation: Analyst Y1 (FY2026): $9.56B = +10.8% vs TTM $8.63B. Analyst Y2 (FY2027): $10.68B = +11.7% vs Y1. Blended 2yr consensus: ~11.3%. Historical 3yr CAGR: 11.7%. Base 5yr CAGR set at 9% — within ±3pp of blended consensus (floor: 11.3% - 3% = 8.3%). Reflects natural deceleration from Y3-5 as base grows. Bear 5% references sequestration scenario. Bull 13% = current analyst pace sustained (aggressive but named-catalyst dependent).
analyticsLog.sectorBenchmarkRow: Industrials — Conservative 14, Median 18, Growth 24. Selected because CACI's economics (cost-plus gov contracts, service delivery model, federally capped profit margins) align with Industrials. Comparable peers: SAIC 15-18x fwd PE, Leidos 20x, BAH 22x. Base exitPE 17x is a modest discount to Industrials median reflecting gov dependency. Bear 13x slightly below conservative; justified by sequestration risk scenario.
